listing.name: Remove Trash Ships
listing.summary: A very simple mod that reduces the player faction's hullfrequency for basebp ships to 0.1.
listing.aiSummary: Reduces the spawn frequency of default basic ships in player fleets once blueprint packages are acquired.

description: Lowers the hull frequency for base blueprints to 0.1, making default ships like kites and hounds rare unless manually prioritized. Essential utility ships such as shuttles and tankers may still appear if no alternatives are known. Removing the mod from a save does not restore default settings, leaving those ships permanently rare in that specific save.

removing.quote: Safe to remove from your save*. The game will load the value from default player faction file (which is to say, no actual value at all, putting these ships on even footing with all other blueprints).
